skill.summary: AI-powered automated job search skill. Searches LinkedIn and Indeed daily, scores jobs against the user's profile, and saves results to a local CSV. Use when...

latestVersion.changelog:
Auto-published from commit 142ceea: feat: auto-archive expired jobs (matches web app rules)

- archiver.py: three rules — expired_30d, auto_rejected, url_dead
  - 30d: New/Interested with no update → expired_30d
  - 60d: Rejected/Passed cleanup → auto_rejected
  - URL check: non-LinkedIn 404/dead-phrase → url_dead
  - LinkedIn skipped (always inconclusive)
  - Dry-run by default, --commit to apply
  - --restore to bring jobs back from archive
  - --stats for archive summary
- run_daily.sh: auto-archive runs after every daily search
- notify.py: shows archived count in daily summary message
- SKILL.md + references/commands.md: archive commands documented
